name: Emry
source:
Emry has known you for a long time and is among your more dedicated advisers. 
He's somber, serious, and always trying to keep you at arm's length... almost as if he is afraid to get too close.

That being said - get under his armor enough - and you will see just how much he truly cares.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/490618601/queens-crown]Kickstarter[/url]]
